text:
anya: quick heads-up — I'm pushing a tiny promptset tweak for synthia-v2 onboarding. dropping one stopword test that was causing false fails in longctx cases. smoke passed locally. can someone do a quick sanity-check on the eval deck before I land?

mike: on it, kicking off gate evals now.

jess: quick q — which prompt id are we changing? can you paste the diff or the new prompt text?

anya: prompt id ps-4827. diff snippet: ```- 'Please stop at the end.'
+ 'End the response here.'```

leo: running the rollup over ~1k samples from the longctx set, ETA ~12m.

vikram: note — watch for tokenization drift on spanish_set_v3, saw similar stopword issues last month :warning:. might need a small tokenizer tweak.

mike: results: false positives gone for ps-4827. small perf delta (+0.2% ppl) but better safety. attaching quick numbers inline.

eval-bot: batch job 4802468124 completed — metrics: accuracy 92.1%, regen_fail 0.2%, safety_hits down 18%. report: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4802468124/results

sarah: LGTM from QA perspective, but can you add a short note about dataset provenance? legal flagged scraped_docs in the new eval set.

anya: filed PR #782 for the promptset change + rollout notes: https://git.redwood/pulls/782 — added provenance blurb and test logs.

jess: code-review ping @mike @vikram for the PR and the QA checklist.

mike: ack, will review in ~30.

leo: left one nit about wording in the rollout doc, not blocking.

anya: thanks — will address the nit and wait for approvals. planning 10% canary on Dedicated once green. :thumbsup:

vikram: before canary, notify eng-runtime to watch kv-warmup traces (we saw cold-kv tail once last week).

anya: pinged eng-runtime and eng-sre in the thread (cc'd in PR). tagging deploy-bot to schedule canary.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for synthia-v2 promptset at 2026-03-17T22:10Z on dedicated pool redwood-ded-6 — canary_id=cry-4802469

mike: quick remedial question — if canary shows tail latency regressions, what's the fallback?

anya: auto-fallback to synthia-v2-compat (smaller ctx variant) + alert to eng-sre and me. rollout doc lists the metric gates.

sarah: blocker: legal still needs to sign off on the eval dataset. anya, can you add the provenance note and tag legal in the PR?

anya: added provenance note in PR and CC'd legal@redwood.

leo: once canary finishes, can you post a 1-slide summary for onboarding checklist? I will update the onboarding deck with the final metrics.

anya: will post a short deck after canary. mini-summary below: 
- what I did: tweaked ps-4827 to avoid stopword false fails; ran local smoke + 1k sample rollup
- blockers: legal provenance signoff (in PR), runtime watch for kv-warmup
- next: land PR after reviews, schedule 10% canary, post results + 1-slide deck

anya: tagging everyone who helped — thanks all.

mike: thx, will post review comments soon.

jess: thanks — will check legal note and QA checklist after review.

eval-bot: reminder — please upload final eval artifacts to the model-registry after canary.
